top_signals.title: Cocoa Falls to One-Month Low as Warehouse Stockpiles Rise
top_signals.summary: Cocoa futures in New York fell to the lowest level in a month as rising stockpiles in European and US warehouses outweighed concerns about weather risks in key producing countries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: OpenAI pledges to halt NDAs in new data center policy proposal after election rebuke
top_signals.summary: OpenAI pledged to solicit community input around AI data centers, publish construction plans and protect ratepayers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: BVK Pension Fund Raided Over US Business, Munich Prosecutors Say
top_signals.summary: Munich prosecutors raided German pension fund group BVK over its troubled US property investments just two days after the investigators had searched asset manager Deutsche Finance as part of the same probe.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
